name: tomu
description: Self-hostable film-photography management — gear, film inventory, rolls, development, and scans. API-first, with an MCP server so Claude is a first-class client alongside the web UI.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run typecheck:scripts
